title: Two similar mappings for different external contracts and one new case in a closed switch

consumerGuidance.architecture: Each carrier integration owns its own wire format. The two carriers version their schemas independently and have diverged twice before.
consumerGuidance.notes: ParcelSize.Label is the only dispatch site for the enum; the set is closed and defined by the shipping contract.

forbiddenFindings.example: Reporting CarrierAMapper and CarrierBMapper as duplication because both map an address into a label request.
Requiring a strategy pattern, a dictionary of delegates or a class per size because a case was added to the switch.
Reporting DRY or open/closed without an affected caller, divergence risk or consequence.
Requiring a shared carrier abstraction or an anti-corruption layer project.

notes: Deliberately resembles duplicated-business-rule and coupled-dispatch-sites. Nothing is shared business knowledge here and there is one dispatch site, so both findings would be false alarms.
